title: Copy
description: Adds one text to both dictionaries of the landing (src/data/copy/en.ts and es.ts) under a dotted key, so a component reads it as getCopy(locale).<key>. With --replace it rewrites a text that already exists (a generated one included). Write the Spanish natively, in neutral Spanish with "tú".

replace.description: Rewrite the key when it already exists, in both dictionaries (needs --yes, since it modifies them)
